pair.title: Connect Novy hood
pair.scan_intro: Make sure the hood is powered and that the Novy app on your phone is closed.
pair.none: Nothing found. Move closer to Homey and search again.
pair.not_found: Device not found anymore, search again.
pair.confirm_intro: Just like the Novy app, Homey asks the hood for a confirmation with the remote control.
pair.confirm_1: Tap Start. The hood switches off and waits for confirmation.
pair.confirm_2: Press the on/off button on your Novy remote control.
pair.confirm_3: As soon as the hood confirms, the device is added.
pair.confirm_now: Press the on/off button on your Novy remote control now.
pair.failed: The hood did not answer. Copy the technical details below and try again.
pair.press_remote: Waiting for the on/off button on the remote…
pair.skip_hint: The Novy app also lets you skip this step; use it if your remote is not at hand.

settings.title: Log
settings.intro: What the app does and which errors occur: Bluetooth connection, commands to the hood and its replies. The log is kept in memory only (max. 256 KB, oldest lines removed first) and starts empty after a restart.
